name: Impatient
summary: Impatient: after you do the Search action, you must discard the card you just searched.

mechanics.timing: After the Search action. Permanent while the sticker is on the character. The sticker does not print when it is gained.
mechanics.effect: After you Search, discard the City card you just scratched.
restrictions: It happens after the Search action, so the scratched box is still resolved
Only the card just searched is discarded
